title: Possible guideline / GDPR violation
body:
* [x] I've read and understood the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/Yoast/wordpress-seo/blob/trunk/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
* [x] I've searched for any related issues and avoided creating a duplicate issue.

### Description.
The Black Friday animated banner that appears in the dashboard has the following link: `https://yoa.st/bf-sale-2019?php_version=7.2&platform=wordpress&platform_version=5.3&software=free&software_version=12.6.1&days_active=30plus&user_language=fr_FR` on my site.
As this is clearly visible, this is a tracking link, from ads right in the site backoffice.

From a "plugin guidelines" point of view, it may appears as a violation (§7 & §11): it's tracking via ads.

From a GDPR point of view, it may appears as a violation too: by following the link I have no way to express my non consent to the collection of these data. In addition, I have no information regarding how this data will be processed nor if these data will be associated with the referer field of the http request. For many users who don't view the full url before clicking, it could be seen as "disloyal collection".

### Solution.
Removes ads from the plugin.

### Technical info

* Which browser is affected (or browsers): 
- [x] Chrome
- [x] Firefox
- [x] Safari
- [ ] Other 

#### Used versions
* WordPress version: 5.3
* Yoast SEO version: 12.6.1
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: Honestly: this is not personally identifiable information. If you click to any site you're giving them lots of true personally identifiable information, this isn't that. We use this data to show you the most useful knowledge base articles we can.
